summary: Tested this session's 3 Create-Production-Order changes + the new per-component 'locations' stock breakdown. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_store_locations.py (7 pytest cases, 7/7 pass) proves 'locations' survives create -> public GET /api/store-requests/{id} -> public queue -> /issue (full + send_to_planner) -> authenticated by-job -> planner /decision (reject) and that legacy docs without the field are tolerated; also re-verified GET /api/production-confirmation/source-of-supply-options/{id} still returns ALL options with is_active (HTBS-SPAIN = 2 options, MAZ42117272-TA = 1) i.e. the auto-pick removal is frontend-only. Iteration_91 regression suite test_store_approval.py re-run serially: 22/22 pass. Frontend was tested through the REAL UI with the documented synthetic vms_session Mongo cookie (super_admin) + Playwright against the live API; the ONLY stubbed call was POST /api/production-confirmation/create-and-release-order (fulfilled with the job_id of a Mongo-seeded paused job) so no real SAP Production Order/Proposal was created - every status poll, store-requests/by-job read and planner /decision POST hit the real backend. Results: (1) after submitting order #1 the form clears (product, qty->1, date, SoS picker gone, submit re-enabled) and a SECOND different order (HTBS-SPAIN, model picked) was submitted immediately while #1 was still in flight - both appeared as separate rows in data-testid=active-orders-table with live Started/Material/Site/Qty/Status columns, statuses updating via polling to 'Waiting for Store' / 'Awaiting Your Decision'. (2) For HTBS-SPAIN (2 options) NOTHING is pre-selected (trigger shows the 'Choose a Production Model' placeholder), sos-choice-required-warning shows, submit is blocked (0 POSTs); picking an option auto-fills+locks Site (P2) and submission then proceeds; MAZ42117272-TA (1 option) still auto-fills with no warning. (3) On the open-lots tab 113 live SAP rows checked: all 58 Finished=Yes rows have Confirm disabled WITH the duplicate-posting tooltip, all 55 Finished=No rows enabled - 0 violations. (4) Active Orders 'View' expands the per-location breakdown (P2: 100 EA / P7: 50 EA / P3: 7.5 KGM) and the partial_pending_planner row shows Confirm/Delete; Delete POSTed {"decision":"reject","actor":"QA Planner"} to the real endpoint, job went to cancelled and the row auto-disappeared on the next poll. (5) Public /storeapproval loads with zero auth and its detail view renders the same per-location breakdown under 'In Stock (By Location)' (name input is now visible there too - iteration_91 UX note fixed). ONE REAL BUG FOUND: the localStorage resume of in-flight jobs never works (see rca). All seeded docs (background_jobs, store_requests, auth_users, auth_sessions) deleted; only 2 genuine user-created BK-0021 store_requests remain (not mine).

minor.issue: The new 'locations' list is the RAW per-site stock rows and can contain the SAME site twice - live doc for BK-0021/SH4.5HR has [{RAY INTERNATIONAL-P1: 36.13}, {RADISH TECHNOLOGY-P2: 836.36}, {RADISH TECHNOLOGY-P2: 4000}, {RADISH TECHNOLOGY-P7: 551.95}, {RADISH TECHNOLOGY-P7: 3500}]. Both UIs map the list 1:1, so the store user / planner sees 'P2: 836.36' and 'P2: 4000' as two rows with no way to tell them apart. Group+sum by site (or expose the differentiating field, e.g. storage location/identified stock).

Reproduced iteration_91's finding again: while the periodic SAP inventory/Standard-Costs refresh was timing out against my431827.businessbydesign.cloud.sap, every API call (incl. pure-Mongo /api/store-requests) timed out / 502'd for several minutes until the backend was restarted.

ui_bugs.issue: The claimed 'a refresh resumes tracking' behaviour is BROKEN. The persist effect (line ~658) is declared BEFORE the restore effect (line ~663), so on every mount it writes '[]' over the stored list and the restore effect then reads an empty array. Verified twice: seeded 2 job_ids into localStorage via add_init_script -> after mount localStorage is '[]' and the Active Orders table shows 0 rows / 'No orders in progress'. Consequence: any page refresh (or nav away and back) permanently loses tracking of in-flight orders, including paused waiting_store_approval / partial_pending_planner jobs whose Confirm/Delete buttons are then unreachable from the UI. Fix: swap the effect order, or guard the persist effect with a hydrated ref/flag.

Clicking Create Production Order with 2+ SoS options and none picked DOES block submission (0 POSTs) but shows the wrong toast: 'Product, Site and Quantity are required' (Site is empty because it is only set by picking a model). The purpose-built message 'This material has multiple valid Production Models - pick one...' is effectively unreachable. Move the sosOptions.length > 1 check above the required-fields check.

The Site input keeps the previous order's value (e.g. 'P2') after a successful submit while siteAutoFilled is reset to false, so it is now an editable stale value the user did not type. Clear siteId (and the 'Locked' helper state) along with the other fields.

critical_code_review_comments: CreateOrderTab: two useEffects share one localStorage key with the writer declared first - hydration silently loses data. Any 'persist to storage' effect must be gated on a hydrated flag.

pollJob's while(true) loop has no terminal condition for paused statuses, so a job left at waiting_store_approval polls /status every 4s forever (2 requests/4s per paused job once by-job is refetched on each status flip). Consider backing off to ~15-30s once a job is in a human-wait state.
ProductionConfirmationPage.js is 1307 lines with 5 components (CreateOrderTab alone ~570 lines) - split CreateOrderTab/ActiveOrdersTable/ConfirmDialog into separate files per the <700-line guideline.
store_approval_service.submit_issue/planner_decision still do read-then-update instead of an atomic filtered find_one_and_update (unchanged from iteration_91).

rca_of_the_issue: activeJobs localStorage bug: in CreateOrderTab the effect that writes localStorage (useEffect on [activeJobs]) is declared before the effect that reads it (useEffect on []). React runs mount effects in declaration order, so the writer fires first with the initial empty state and overwrites the persisted seed with '[]'; the reader then finds nothing and no pollJob is restarted. Reproduced by pre-seeding the key with 2 valid job_ids: localStorage read back as '[]' and Active Orders rendered its empty state, while the same job_ids tracked fine when registered through a form submit in the same session. Fix = hydrate first (or skip the first persist run).
